title: Bait Ball
description: Near Baja California in Mexico, a group of striped marlins corral hundreds of smaller fish into a dense formation known as a bait ball, before feasting on their prey. Photographer Brooke Pyke used her underwater camera to capture “these majestic, agile hunters” as they chased the fish to the surface, she says, much like dogs herding sheep.
translated_description: 在墨西哥下加利福尼亚州附近海域，一群条纹枪鱼将数百条小鱼围拢成一个密集的鱼群，形成所谓的“饵球”，随后尽情享用猎物。摄影师布鲁克·派克用她的水下相机捕捉到了“这些雄伟而敏捷的猎手”将鱼群追赶到水面的画面，她说，这就像牧羊犬驱赶羊群一样。
